desc: Derive and verify the reverse-processing invariant that maps each insertion position `P_i` to the `P_i`-th empty final slot.
Implement a Fenwick tree initialized with `1` at every position to represent available slots.
Implement Fenwick-tree k-th order statistic search to find the index of the `k`-th available slot.
Process values from `N` down to `1`, place each value in its selected slot, and remove that slot from availability.
Handle stdin parsing and output the completed array space-separated.
Run the provided sample tests and verify their outputs.
